name: How do plumbers fix high water pressure?

mainEntity.name: How do plumbers fix high water pressure?

acceptedAnswer.text: Plumbers typically fix high water pressure by installing or replacing a pressure reducing valve (PRV) on the main water line entering your home. A PRV regulates the incoming water pressure to a safe, consistent level, usually between 50-70 PSI. The plumber will first test the existing pressure, assess the condition of any current PRV, and then install or adjust a new valve to ensure optimal pressure throughout your plumbing system. They can also check for other underlying causes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Plumbers fix high water pressure by installing or replacing a pressure reducing valve (PRV) on the main water line to regulate pressure.
